limitations: 300 consecutive raw rows per retained source at the saved parent position, not a corpus-wide or randomly sharded audit.
Deterministic lexical math/code filters can miss implicit topics and reject useful prose.
Web prose and existing Cosmopedia also contain factual and extraction noise; existing synthetic share stays at 10%. No per-document factual verifier is claimed.
Exact text, IDs and URLs exclude overlaps with rebuilt reference documents; semantic near-duplicates and complete historical training duplicates are not guaranteed absent.

rejected_sources.faq: FinePhrase samples included unsupported factual claims and malformed question/answer labeling.
rejected_sources.tutorial: FinePhrase samples included incorrect English morphology, conflicting scientific claims, and malformed lists.

reweighting: Raw receipts used the preserved six-source candidate corpus. Each retained source and every selection setting is unchanged. Only token weights and source removal differ; mixture behavior is separately fixture-tested.
scope: Eligible for a bounded data-mixture pilot; stream, schema, topic-screen and spot review, not a factual-accuracy certification.
